method: CTMSR Stage 2 (You et al., ICCV 2025): E10_ctmsr fine-tuned with Distribution Trajectory Matching (DTM) + the CT loss

consistency._source: as E10; the CT loss keeps E10's final curriculum value, T = s1 = 3 intervals

dtm._source: paper 4.1 + supp. A.3-A.4 and options/train/ctmsr_train.yml (dtm_iter 2000, lr 5e-5, weight 1.6, t_min 0.1 / t_max 0.5 of 3 + 1 grid points -> index 1, i.e. sigma = alpha = 1/3; frozen copy refreshed every 1000 iterations; 'improved' weight 1 / mean|x_hat0 - x0|)
